sqf: private _fobPos = missionNamespace getVariable ['CLAUDE_FOB_POS', [0,0,0]]; if (_fobPos isEqualTo [0,0,0]) then { private _airfields = nearestLocations [[worldSize/2, worldSize/2, 0], ['Airport'], 50000]; _fobPos = if (count _airfields > 0) then { position (_airfields select 0) } else { [worldSize * 0.3, worldSize * 0.5, 0] }; }; ['Setting up WEST respawn point...'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0]; private _respawnMkr = createMarker ['respawn_west', _fobPos]; _respawnMkr setMarkerType 'respawn_inf'; _respawnMkr setMarkerColor 'ColorBLUFOR'; _respawnMkr setMarkerAlpha 0.5; private _respawnMkr2 = createMarker ['respawn_west_vehicles', [(_fobPos select 0) + 50, (_fobPos select 1) + 50, 0]]; _respawnMkr2 setMarkerType 'respawn_motor'; _respawnMkr2 setMarkerColor 'ColorBLUFOR'; _respawnMkr2 setMarkerAlpha 0.5; ['WEST respawn points established.'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0]; ['Teleporting players to FOB...'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0]; { private _tpPos = [(_fobPos select 0) + (random 10) - 5, (_fobPos select 1) + (random 10) - 5, 0]; _x setPos _tpPos; } forEach allPlayers; ['All players at FOB WARHAMMER.'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0];
